A.name: Stack A: Sovereign Sub-800ms WebRTC Voice
A.tagline: LiveKit routes WebRTC/SIP audio, Speaches transcribes <220ms, Kokoro-FastAPI speaks <150ms, Cal.com books appointments mid-call.

B.name: Stack B: SIP Telephony, Piper TTS & Call Routing
B.tagline: Asterisk PBX terminates real SIP phone trunks, OpenedAI Speech runs Piper neural TTS, Open WebUI tunes scripts, n8n sends SMS & CRM updates.

livekit.name: LiveKit WebRTC & SIP
livekit.role: Ultra-low-latency WebRTC & SIP media server powering Pipecat voice streams
livekit.first_run: Runs in dev mode locally on ws://localhost:6500 (API key: devkey / secret: secret) ready for Pipecat.

kokoro-tts.name: Kokoro-FastAPI TTS
kokoro-tts.role: Human-grade OpenAI-compatible neural TTS with <150ms first-byte latency + Web UI
kokoro-tts.first_run: Open /web/ to audition voices or POST to /v1/audio/speech from Pipecat at <150ms TTFB.

speaches-stt.name: Speaches Realtime STT
speaches-stt.role: Streaming Faster-Whisper speech-to-text server for sub-250ms turn detection
speaches-stt.first_run: Swagger UI on /docs; Pipecat connects to http://host.docker.internal:6520/v1 for real-time STT.

calcom-voice.name: Cal.com Voice Booking
calcom-voice.role: Live calendar slot lookup & mid-call appointment booking API
calcom-voice.first_run: Create your receptionist booking calendar and paste your Cal.com API key into Pipecat tool calls.

asterisk.name: Asterisk SIP PBX
asterisk.role: Self-hosted SIP phone trunk router with ARI REST/WebSocket audio bridge
asterisk.first_run: Exposes SIP :5060 and ARI HTTP :6600 to bridge Twilio/Telnyx/VoIP.ms trunks straight into Pipecat.

openedai-speech.name: OpenedAI Speech (Piper)
openedai-speech.role: Drop-in OpenAI /v1/audio/speech server powered by ultra-fast CPU Piper voices
openedai-speech.first_run: Runs blazingly fast on CPU-only VPS nodes; test voices via Swagger UI at /docs.

voice-llm.name: Open WebUI Voice Brain
voice-llm.role: Local LLM receptionist prompt studio & objection-handling knowledge base
voice-llm.first_run: No login locally (WEBUI_AUTH=False). Test receptionist system prompts against local Ollama.

n8n-voice.name: n8n Call Router
n8n-voice.role: Post-call SMS confirmations, Cal.com webhooks & Twenty CRM call logging
n8n-voice.first_run: Import /automations/stack_a_pipecat_call_booking.n8n.json to automate post-call booking SMS & CRM sync.
